sentences.en: Good morning and welcome, everybody.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎大家。

sentences.en: I'm Jenny Stewart and I'm the Staff Manager here at the exhibition centre.
sentences.zh: 我是珍妮·斯图尔特，是本展览中心的员工经理。

sentences.en: We're expecting this year's International Travel Exhibition to attract over 10,000 visitors a day, ladies and gentlemen, and you are among the two hundred extra staff recruited to help look after them.
sentences.zh: 各位女士、先生，今年的国际旅游展览会预计每天将吸引超过一万名参观者，而你们是为协助接待他们而特别招募的两百名额外工作人员之一。

sentences.en: Now, to help things run smoothly, we have divided you into four teams - the blue team, the green team, the red team, and the yellow team.
sentences.zh: 为了确保各项工作顺利进行，我们已将你们分为四支队伍：蓝队、绿队、红队和黄队。

sentences.en: So first I'll explain how the teams are divided up, and then we'll be giving you colour-coded T-shirts so we can identify you more easily.
sentences.zh: 首先，我将说明各队的人员分配方式，随后会向你们发放按颜色编码的T恤，以便我们更轻松地识别各位。

sentences.en: First of all, those who will be looking after the phones and handling all calls regarding the exhibition, you will be on the red team.
sentences.zh: 首先，负责接听电话并处理所有与展览会相关来电的人员，将编入红队。

sentences.en: Now, we've also put the entrance staff on the red team and you'll be stamping the entrance tickets 011 and giving out publicity leaflets, OK?
sentences.zh: 此外，入口处的工作人员也划归红队，你们的工作包括在入场门票上盖章（编号011）以及分发宣传单页，明白了吗？

sentences.en: Those of you involved in distributing entrance tickets will be on the yellow team and we've also put those of you who'll be staffing the information booths around the conference centre on the yellow team, so you'll be getting a yellow T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 负责分发入场门票的人员将编入黄队；同时，负责在会议中心各信息咨询台提供服务的人员也编入黄队，因此你们将领取黄色T恤。

sentences.en: Now, most of the hospitality staff have been put in the blue team, so the chefs among you and the kitchen hands will 212 all need a blue T-shirt, but, because of the sheer numbers, all waiting staff will be on the yellow team, and this includes the bar staff among you.
sentences.zh: 大部分礼宾服务人员被安排在蓝队，所以你们当中担任厨师及厨房助手的人员均需领取蓝色T恤；但由于人数众多，所有侍应人员（包括你们当中的酒吧工作人员）均编入黄队。

sentences.en: Those who will be monitoring and directing the traffic in the car parks are on the green team, so you'll need to get a green T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 负责监控及疏导停车场交通的人员属于绿队，因此你们需领取绿色T恤。

sentences.en: This year we've also employed a considerable number of attendants to direct the human traffic around the conference centre.
sentences.zh: 今年我们还雇用了相当数量的引导员，专门负责在会议中心内疏导人流。

sentences.en: Now, you'll be working in the exhibition hall at all times, giving directions and generally helping people whenever you can, and you will be in the red team, so please collect a red T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 你们将始终在展览大厅内工作，负责指路，并尽可能为参观者提供各种帮助；你们属于红队，请务必领取红色T恤。

sentences.en: Right, now that everyone knows what team they're in, we'll get on with the orientation and training programme and first I'll run through the rest of today's programme, which you should have in front of you, so that you can get a general idea of what else is in store today.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在大家已清楚自己所属的队伍，我们将继续开展入职介绍与培训计划。首先，我将简要说明今天剩余的活动安排——你们手头应该已有一份日程表，以便对今天的其他安排有个总体了解。

sentences.en: This introduction finishes at 9.30 and then you'll be hearing from Anne Smith.
sentences.zh: 本次开场介绍将于9:30结束，随后将由安妮·史密斯为大家讲话。

sentences.en: Anne works in the accounts department on level two and she looks after all temporary staff, and so she is the person to see if you have any problems regarding pay.
sentences.zh: 安妮在二层的财务部工作，负责管理所有临时员工，因此若你们在薪资方面遇到任何问题，可直接联系她。

sentences.en: Anne will be explaining when and how you get this.
sentences.zh: 安妮将详细说明薪资发放的时间与方式。

sentences.en: She will also be handing out your tax forms.
sentences.zh: 她还将向你们分发税务表格。

sentences.en: And I will just stress that all tax forms must be completed and returned to Anne before your pay can be processed.
sentences.zh: 我在此特别强调：所有税务表格必须填写完毕并交还给安妮，之后才能处理你们的薪资。

sentences.en: Following Anne's talk you'll hear from Peter Chen, our Conference Manager, and he will be going over a plan of the conference centre with you, which will help you to www.TopSage.com 7.3000 orient yourselves.
sentences.zh: 安妮讲话结束后，将由我们的会议经理彼得·陈为大家讲话；他将带领你们熟悉会议中心的平面图，帮助你们快速熟悉环境。

sentences.en: He will also go through the security arrangements with you and show C you the fire exits.
sentences.zh: 他还将向你们介绍安保安排，并带你们查看消防出口。

sentences.en: Then at 10.30, there will be a coffee break in the staff canteen, which is C.cOm located down on the ground floor.
sentences.zh: 然后，10:30将在员工餐厅举行茶歇，该餐厅位于一层（地面层）。

sentences.en: Now, after the break we'll be moving to a different location for a video presentation, so instead of coming back here, we'd like you all to go to Lecture Room three-one-onc.
sentences.zh: 茶歇结束后，我们将移至另一地点观看视频演示；请勿返回此处，而是全部前往三号报告厅（311室）。

sentences.en: You'll find it on this same level, just down the hall, and there you will be shown a video about important safety issues in the workplace, called Safety at Work.
sentences.zh: 该报告厅位于同一楼层，沿走廊前行即可到达；在那里，你们将观看一部名为《职场安全》的视频，内容涉及工作中重要的安全事项。

sentences.en: We'll finish off the morning with lunch, which should give everyone a chance to meet and get to know each other, and we'll be serving you a buffet lunch in the Main Hall, which is on the first floor, from 12.00 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 上午的活动将以午餐收尾，这将为大家提供相互认识、彼此交流的机会；我们将于12:00起在一楼主厅为大家提供自助午餐。

sentences.en: After lunch you'll be divided up into your teams to meet your team leaders and we're hoping to be all finished by I 3.00 so I won't delay you any longer, and I'll hand over to . ..
sentences.zh: 午餐后，你们将按所属队伍分组，与各自的队长见面；我们预计全部活动将于13:00前结束，因此我就不多耽误大家时间了，现在将主持权交给……
